name: Qilin BYOVD Driver Staging Service and NtLoadDriver
description: Detects vulnerable-driver staging, kernel-service creation, service ImagePath registry changes, and direct NtLoadDriver/ZwLoadDriver API activity. Confidence: High for the hash, named drivers, and native-load APIs; Medium for a generic user-writable .sys drop. Correlate related events within 5 minutes.
query: any where (event.category == "file" and event.action == "creation" and (file.hash.sha256 == "ea0b9eecf4ad5ec8c14aec13de7d661e7615018b1a3c65464bf5eca9bbf6ded3" or file.path : ("*\\rwdrv.sys", "*\\hlpdrv.sys") or (file.extension == "sys" and file.path : ("*\\Users\\*", "*\\ProgramData\\*", "*\\Temp\\*")))) or (event.category == "process" and process.name : "sc.exe" and process.command_line : "*create*" and process.command_line : "*type=*" and process.command_line : "*kernel*") or (event.category == "registry" and registry.path : "*\\Services\\*" and registry.value : "ImagePath" and registry.data.strings : "*.sys") or process.Ext.api.name : ("NtLoadDriver", "ZwLoadDriver")

technique.name: Impair Defenses: Disable or Modify Tools

author: F0RT1KA Detection Rules Generator
false_positives: Approved driver installation and hardware update workflows; validate signer, hash, service name, and installation parent before tuning.
Driver-development or defensive research tools; isolate research hosts rather than broadly excluding paths.

name: Qilin Security Discovery and Foxit msimg32 Sideload
description: Detects SecurityCenter2 antivirus enumeration, Win32_OperatingSystem discovery, and FoxitPDFReader loading msimg32.dll outside Windows system directories. Confidence: High for the sideload branch; Medium for discovery alone. Discovery commands from one process should be correlated over 5 minutes.
query: any where (event.category == "process" and (process.command_line : ("*SecurityCenter2*AntiVirusProduct*", "*AntiVirusProduct*SecurityCenter2*", "*Win32_OperatingSystem*") or (process.name : "tasklist.exe" and process.args : "*csv*") or (process.name : "sc.exe" and process.args : "query"))) or (event.category == "library" and process.name : "FoxitPDFReader.exe" and dll.name : "msimg32.dll" and not dll.path : ("*\\Windows\\System32\\*", "*\\Windows\\SysWOW64\\*"))
author: F0RT1KA Detection Rules Generator
false_positives: Inventory, vulnerability-management, and support tools; tune approved signer and parent combinations.
Portable or repackaged Foxit installations; verify the DLL signer and hash rather than excluding every non-system load.

name: Qilin Remote LoadLibrary Thread into Svchost
description: Detects CreateRemoteThread/NtCreateThreadEx/RtlCreateUserThread activity targeting svchost.exe and pwndll.dll module loads in svchost outside Windows directories. Confidence: High for an untrusted source and non-system module. Review thread start address and loaded-module path to confirm LoadLibrary-style injection.
query: any where (process.Ext.api.name : ("CreateRemoteThread", "NtCreateThreadEx", "RtlCreateUserThread") and process.Ext.target.process.name : "svchost.exe") or (event.category == "library" and process.name : "svchost.exe" and (dll.name : "pwndll.dll" or (dll.path : ("*\\Users\\*", "*\\ProgramData\\*", "*\\Temp\\*") and not dll.path : ("*\\Windows\\System32\\*", "*\\Windows\\SysWOW64\\*"))))
author: F0RT1KA Detection Rules Generator
false_positives: Debuggers, profilers, accessibility software, and endpoint security products; inspect source signer and thread start address before creating narrow exclusions.

name: Qilin LSASS Access or Security Process Termination
description: Detects OpenProcess/NtOpenProcess against LSASS and TerminateProcess/NtTerminateProcess against common security processes. Confidence: High for an unexpected source. LSASS handle access alone does not prove a dump; inspect the desired-access mask for PROCESS_VM_READ and correlate security termination with BYOVD activity within 10 minutes.
query: process where event.type == "access" and ((process.Ext.api.name : ("OpenProcess", "NtOpenProcess") and process.Ext.target.process.name : "lsass.exe") or (process.Ext.api.name : ("TerminateProcess", "NtTerminateProcess") and process.Ext.target.process.name : ("MsMpEng.exe", "CSFalconService.exe", "CrowdStrike.exe", "SentinelAgent.exe", "MsSense.exe", "SophosEndpointDefense.exe")))

technique.name: Impair Defenses: Disable or Modify Tools

author: F0RT1KA Detection Rules Generator
false_positives: Credential-protection, crash-dump, and support tools accessing LSASS; tune verified signer/path/access-mask combinations only.
Security-product upgrades and vendor service control; require documented maintenance and a verified vendor source before excluding.

name: Qilin File Encryption and Recovery Inhibition
description: Detects Qilin-suffixed encrypted files and vssadmin shadow deletion or bcdedit recovery disablement. Confidence: High for recovery commands or at least 3 encrypted files from one process in 2 minutes; Medium for a single extension match. Validate original-file deletion and ransom-note activity.
query: any where (event.category == "file" and (file.extension == "qilin" or file.path : "*\\README-RECOVER.txt")) or (event.category == "process" and ((process.name : "vssadmin.exe" and process.command_line : "*delete*" and process.command_line : "*shadows*") or (process.name : "bcdedit.exe" and process.command_line : "*recoveryenabled*" and process.command_line : "*no*")))
author: F0RT1KA Detection Rules Generator
false_positives: Approved backup maintenance and recovery administration; tune management parent and change window.
Benign software using the same extension or recovery-note name; require burst and deletion corroboration.
